//push: Where a good run lands: 'branch' (its work branch), 'main' (also fast-forwards the default branch), any branch name such as 'preview' (a client can look there), or 'none'. Unset asks the kind rule: a system task → main, client work → branch. Override per project with projects.<slug>.push. On a hosted site the portal owns the preview branch.
//defaultBranch: The branch 'push: main' means. Unset asks the repo's origin/HEAD, then main.
//dshHome: The Harness home the node's dsh runs read profiles, credentials and sessions from. Unset: the node's $DSH_HOME, else ~/.dsh. Use ~/.dsh-admin for the DSH Admin app.
